option_relations.rationale: The option describes infection-related glomerulonephritis secondary to a specific infection, which is not directly related to ANCA-positive glomerulonephritis.
The option describes focal segmental necrotizing immune-complex glomerulonephritis triggered by chronic infection, which is not directly related to ANCA-positive glomerulonephritis.
The option describes membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (infection-related), which is not directly related to ANCA-positive glomerulonephritis.
The option describes LVAD-related infective endocarditis with secondary immune complex glomerulonephritis, which is not directly related to ANCA-positive glomerulonephritis.
